full.description: This is a gross pathology photograph of an opened blood vessel, specifically an aorta. The specimen displays severe atherosclerotic disease with extensive plaque buildup, calcification, and ulceration along the intimal surface. A thrombus or atheromatous debris is visible within the lumen. The overall appearance is characteristic of severe complicated atherosclerosis.

random.description: This image is a gross pathology photograph showing a longitudinal section of a human aorta. The specimen displays severe, complicated atherosclerosis characterized by extensive yellowish atheromatous plaques, ulceration, calcification, and luminal narrowing. An area of hemorrhage or thrombosis is also visible within the severely diseased vessel wall. The findings are indicative of severe atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease.
